steps.en: Check the host can actually run Kata sandboxes
steps.zh: 先确认宿主机能跑 Kata 沙箱

steps.en: Put the runtime artifacts on every node that should host Kata pods
steps.zh: 把运行时铺到每个要跑 Kata pod 的节点

steps.en: Select the runtime per pod in the manifest
steps.zh: 在 manifest 里按 pod 选中这个运行时

steps.en: Boots a lightweight VM with its own guest kernel for that pod
steps.zh: 为该 pod 启动一台带独立客户机内核的轻量虚拟机

steps.en: Runs the workload's containers inside the VM via an in-guest agent
steps.zh: 在虚拟机里由 guest agent 拉起工作负载的容器

steps.en: Drives the VM through the selected hypervisor
steps.zh: 用选定的 hypervisor 驱动这台虚拟机

value.en: Hypervisor-grade isolation while you keep pods, images and CRI — you never build a container runtime
value.zh: 拿到 hypervisor 级隔离，同时保留 pod、镜像与 CRI——不用自己造容器运行时

sources: https://github.com/kata-containers/kata-containers/blob/main/docs/quick-start-guide.md (kata-runtime check; kata-deploy Helm install; runtimeClassName: kata-qemu-runtime-rs; kata-quickstart.yaml)
https://github.com/kata-containers/kata-containers#introduction (lightweight VMs that feel like containers; runtime + agent + hypervisors)
